---
  title: "ms-specparam regreesion and plotting code"
---
  
  Read in data from tables and organize it to explore in regressions 
See how it relates to age


Note variables names represent the following algorithms
Van == default specparam
BIC == model-selection specparam
SB == conservative specparam

See paper for details

```{r cleaning data and demographics}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(BayesFactor)
library(ggseg)
#library(ggsegDesterieux)
library(colorspace)

cbbPalette= c("#4f89e0", "#f5ec6c",'#156605',"#76D7C4","#268236", '#4d3d87','#593d80', '#3b49e3')

# pool together demographics from all parts
demo=read.csv('~/Documents/CAMCAN_outputs/CAMCAN_Analysis/standard_data.csv')
demo2=read.csv('~/Desktop/Xiaobo_age_data/fulldemo_fromCAMCAN_test.csv')
demo$CCID=paste('sub',demo$CCID, sep = '_')
ids=read.csv('~/Documents/CAMCAN_outputs/CAMCAN_Analysis/subject_codes.csv')
index=demo$CCID %in% ids$Ids
demo=demo[index,]

demo$Group[demo$Age>=18 & demo$Age <45]= "young adult"
demo$Group[demo$Age>=45 & demo$Age <65]= "adult"
demo$Group[demo$Age>=65 & demo$Age <90]= "older adult"

full_demo=read.csv('~/Documents/CAMCAN_outputs/approved_data.csv')
full_demo$CCID=paste('sub',full_demo$CCID, sep = '_')
index=full_demo$CCID %in% ids$Ids
full_demo=full_demo[index,]

# read in csv of slopes for each hyperparameter setting
exponent_Van= read.csv('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/outputs/aperiodic_exponent_VanREV.csv', header = FALSE)
exponent_BIC= read.csv('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/outputs/aperiodic_exponent_BICREV.csv', header = FALSE)
exponent_SB= read.csv('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/outputs/aperiodic_exponent_SB.csv', header = FALSE)

# read in csv of offset
offset_Van= read.csv('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/outputs/aperiodic_offset_VanREV.csv', header = FALSE)
offset_BIC= read.csv('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/outputs/aperiodic_offset_BICREV.csv', header = FALSE)
offset_SB= read.csv('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/outputs/aperiodic_offset_SB.csv', header = FALSE)

# avg MSE of spectral model fit
MSE_Van= read.csv('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/outputs/fit_mse_VanREV.csv', header = FALSE)
MSE_BIC= read.csv('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/outputs/fit_mse_BICREV.csv', header = FALSE)
BF_BIC= read.csv('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/outputs/BF_BICREV.csv', header = FALSE)

peak_cf_Van= read.csv('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/outputs/Peak_center_freq_VanREV.csv', header = FALSE)
peak_cf_BIC= read.csv('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/outputs/Peak_center_freq_BICREV.csv', header = FALSE)

peak_amp_Van= read.csv('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/outputs/Amplitude_freq_VanREV.csv', header = FALSE)
peak_amp_BIC= read.csv('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/outputs/Amplitude_freq_BICREV.csv', header = FALSE)

peak_std_Van= read.csv('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/outputs/Std_freq_VanREV.csv', header = FALSE)
peak_std_BIC= read.csv('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/outputs/Std_freq_BICREV.csv', header = FALSE)

# organized atlas info (summary of ROI)
atlas= read.csv('~/Desktop/Xiaobo_age_data/Destrieux_atlas.csv')



```

MSE is significantly lower in BIC FOOOF but this does not interact with age


```{r plot model fit compare groups BF brain map}

someData3= tidyr::tibble(atlas$region, colMeans(MSE_Van), atlas$hemi, 'Vanilla')
someData2= tidyr::tibble(atlas$region, colMeans(MSE_BIC), atlas$hemi, 'BIC')
colnames(someData2)= c('region', 'MSE', 'hemi', 'algorithm')
colnames(someData3)= c('region', 'MSE', 'hemi', 'algorithm')
someData3=rbind(someData3, someData2)
someData3= someData3[!is.na(someData3$algorithm),]
someData3$algorithm= factor(someData3$algorithm, levels = c(NA,'Vanilla', 'BIC'))
someData3$region= factor(someData3$region)

someData3 %>%
  group_by(algorithm) %>% 
  brain_join(desterieux) %>% 
  reposition_brain(hemi ~ side) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(fill =MSE)) + 
  geom_sf(show.legend = TRUE) + 
  facet_wrap( ~ algorithm) +  scale_fill_continuous_sequential(palette= 'Sunset', rev= FALSE) +  scale_color_continuous_sequential(palette= 'Sunset', rev= FALSE) +
  theme_void() + scale_color_manual('white')

ggsave('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/figures/REVIEW_Brain_map_MSE_compare.pdf', device = "pdf")



# box plots of MSE model fit
data4plot= data.frame(MSE= c(rowMeans(MSE_Van), rowMeans(MSE_BIC)),
                      algorithm= factor(x = rep(c('liberal','ms-'), each=606), levels = c('liberal', 'ms-')) , age= factor(demo$Group, c('young adult', 'adult', 'older adult')), age_raw= demo$Age)

ggplot(data4plot, aes(algorithm, MSE, fill=algorithm)) + 
  ggdist::stat_halfeye(adjust = .5, width = .5, .width = 0, justification = -.5, alpha=0.5, point_alpha= 0) + 
  geom_boxplot(width = .2, outlier.shape = NA, outlier.size = 0.001, colour= '#888888') + ggpubr::theme_classic2() + scale_fill_manual(values=cbbPalette) + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.008))

ggsave('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/figures/REVIEW_boxplot_MSE_compare_withSRAWBERRY2.pdf', device = "pdf")


RVAideMemoire::perm.t.test(rowMeans(MSE_BIC),rowMeans(MSE_Van), nperm=1000)

RVAideMemoire::perm.t.test(data4plot$MSE[data4plot$algorithm=='ms-'],data4plot$MSE[data4plot$algorithm=='liberal'], nperm=1000, paired=TRUE)

#t = -48.11, p-value = 0.001998


SDpooled = sqrt((sd(data4plot$MSE[data4plot$algorithm=='ms-'], na.rm = TRUE)^2 + sd(data4plot$MSE[data4plot$algorithm=='liberal'], na.rm = TRUE)^2)/2)
Cohen_D = (mean(data4plot$MSE[data4plot$algorithm=='ms-'], na.rm = TRUE) - mean(data4plot$MSE[data4plot$algorithm=='liberal'], na.rm = TRUE)) /SDpooled
# -1.804185

# plot Bayes factor for periodic activity 
someData3= data.frame(region= atlas$region, BF= log10(colMeans(BF_BIC)), hemi= atlas$hemi, algorithm='BIC')
colnames(someData3)= c('region', 'BF', 'hemi', 'algorithm')

someData3$BF[someData3$BF >1] =1
someData3$BF[someData3$BF < -25] =-25

someData3= na.omit(someData3)
someData3= someData3[!is.na(someData3$region),]
ggplot(someData3) +
  geom_brain(atlas = desterieux, 
             position = position_brain(hemi ~ side),
             aes(fill = BF)) +  scale_fill_continuous_sequential(palette= 'Terrain', rev= TRUE, limits= c(-25,1)) +  scale_color_continuous_sequential(palette= 'Terrain', rev= TRUE) + theme_void() + scale_color_manual('white')

ggsave('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/figures/REVIEW_Brain_map_BF.pdf', device = "pdf")

```




```{r plot fmse}

fmse_Van=read.csv('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/outputs/fmse_mean_VanREV.csv', header = FALSE)
fmse_BIC=read.csv('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/outputs/fmse_mean_BICREV.csv', header = FALSE)
fmse_SB=read.csv('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/outputs/fmse_mean_SB.csv', header = FALSE)

stderror <- function(x) sd(x)/sqrt(length(x))

data4plot= data.frame(fmse= c(colMeans(fmse_Van),colMeans(fmse_BIC)), sd_fmse= c(1.96*apply(fmse_Van, 2, stderror),1.96*apply(fmse_BIC, 2, stderror)),
                      algorithm= factor(x = rep(c('Vanilla', 'BIC'), each=79), levels = c('Vanilla', 'BIC')), freq=  seq(1,40,0.5))


ggplot(data4plot, aes(x= freq, y = fmse, fill= algorithm,colour= algorithm, ymin=fmse-sd_fmse, ymax=fmse+sd_fmse)) + geom_ribbon(alpha=0.5, colour= NA) + geom_line() + ggpubr::theme_classic2() + coord_cartesian(xlim = c(1, 40) ) + scale_fill_manual(values=cbbPalette[c(1,3)]) + scale_color_manual(values=cbbPalette[c(1,3)])

ggsave('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/figures/REVIEW_FMSE_plot.pdf', device = "pdf")


```

```{r plot peak count per ROI}
Cohen_D = (mean(rowMeans(peaks_count_total_BIC), na.rm = TRUE) - mean(rowMeans(peaks_count_total_Van), na.rm = TRUE)) /SDpooled
# -0.7498627

# run regression to check if fewer peaks were fit by age group
```

```{r run stats on exponents, offset, MSE, peak count }


data4plot=data.frame(exponent=c(stack(exponent_Van)[,1], stack(exponent_BIC)[,1]), 
           algorithm= rep(c('Vanilla', 'BIC'), each=606*148),
           age= demo$Group, age_raw= demo$Age, subID= demo$CCID)

data4plot$algorithm= factor(data4plot$algorithm, levels = c('Vanilla', 'BIC'))
data4plot$age= factor(data4plot$age, levels = c('young adult', 'adult', 'older adult'))


data4plot=data.frame(exponent=c(rowMeans(exponent_Van), rowMeans(exponent_BIC)), 
           algorithm= rep(c('Vanilla', 'BIC'), each=606),
           age= demo$Group, age_raw= demo$Age, subID= demo$CCID)

data4plot$algorithm= factor(data4plot$algorithm, levels = c('Vanilla', 'BIC'))
data4plot$age= factor(data4plot$age, levels = c('young adult', 'adult', 'older adult'))

data4plot$exponent= scale(data4plot$exponent)
data4plot$age_raw= scale(data4plot$age_raw)
lm0=lme4::lmer(exponent ~(1 | subID), data4plot)
lm1=lme4::lmer(exponent ~age_raw + (1 | subID), data4plot)
lm11=lme4::lmer(exponent ~algorithm + (1 | subID), data4plot)
lm2=lme4::lmer(exponent ~algorithm + age_raw + (1 | subID), data4plot)
lm3=lme4::lmer(exponent ~algorithm *age_raw + (1 | subID), data4plot)

anova(lm0,lm1,lm2,lm3)
sjPlot::tab_model(lm3)

exp((BIC(lm2) - BIC(lm3))/2) # 0.3368224
exp((BIC(lm0) - BIC(lm1))/2) #  1.386513e+31
exp((BIC(lm0) - BIC(lm11))/2) # 0.7276648

lmVan=lm(exponent ~age_raw , data4plot[data4plot$algorithm == 'Vanilla',])
sjPlot::tab_model(lmVan)
lmVan=lm(exponent ~age_raw , data4plot[data4plot$algorithm == 'BIC',])
sjPlot::tab_model(lmVan)


## offset 


data4plot=data.frame(offset=c(rowMeans(offset_Van), rowMeans(offset_BIC)), 
           algorithm= rep(c('Vanilla', 'BIC'), each=606),
           age= demo$Group, age_raw= demo$Age, subID= demo$CCID)

data4plot$algorithm= factor(data4plot$algorithm, levels = c('Vanilla', 'BIC'))
data4plot$age= factor(data4plot$age, levels = c('young adult', 'adult', 'older adult'))


data4plot$offset= scale(data4plot$offset)
data4plot$age_raw= scale(data4plot$age_raw)
lm0=lme4::lmer(offset ~(1 | subID), data4plot)
lm1=lme4::lmer(offset ~age_raw + (1 | subID), data4plot)
lm11=lme4::lmer(offset ~algorithm + (1 | subID), data4plot)
lm2=lme4::lmer(offset ~algorithm + age_raw + (1 | subID), data4plot)
lm3=lme4::lmer(offset ~algorithm *age_raw + (1 | subID), data4plot)

anova(lm0,lm1,lm2,lm3)
sjPlot::tab_model(lm3)

exp((BIC(lm2) - BIC(lm3))/2)
```

``` {r Peak proximity simulations}
library(dplyr)

data=read.csv('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/fixed_algo/Figure2_004/pk_values_004.csv')
error_ap = read.csv('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/fixed_algo/Figure2_004/err_ap.csv')

data$Vanerror_expon = plyr::mapvalues(data$tru_sim, 1:5000, error_ap$exponent)
data$Vanerror_offset = plyr::mapvalues(data$tru_sim, 1:5000, error_ap$offset)

BICerror_ap = read.csv('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/fixed_algo/Figure2_004/err_ap_BIC.csv')

data$BICerror_expon = plyr::mapvalues(data$tru_sim, 1:5000, BICerror_ap$exponent)
data$BICerror_offset = plyr::mapvalues(data$tru_sim, 1:5000, BICerror_ap$offset)

BIC_peaks = read.csv('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/fixed_algo/Figure2_004/bic_values.csv')
Van_peaks = read.csv('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/fixed_algo/Figure2_004/van_values.csv')

peak_params = read.csv('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/fixed_algo/Figure2_004/err_pk.csv')
data$Vanerror_peaks_cf[!is.na(data$Van)] = peak_params$cf
data$Vanerror_peaks_amp[!is.na(data$Van)] = peak_params$amp
data$Vanerror_peaks_sd[!is.na(data$Van)] = peak_params$sd

BICpeak_params = read.csv('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/fixed_algo/Figure2_004/err_pk_BIC.csv')
data$BICerror_peaks_cf[!is.na(data$MS)] = BICpeak_params$cf
data$BICerror_peaks_amp[!is.na(data$MS)] = BICpeak_params$amp
data$BICerror_peaks_sd[!is.na(data$MS)] = BICpeak_params$sd

data=data %>% group_by(tru_sim) %>% mutate(range_cf = max(tru_cf)-min(tru_cf))
data=data %>% group_by(tru_sim) %>% mutate(sd_cf = sd(tru_cf))
data=data %>% group_by(tru_sim) %>% mutate(No_peak = n())
data=data %>% group_by(tru_sim) %>% mutate(BIC_peaksRec = sum(tru_sim == BIC_peaks$bic_sim))
data=data %>% group_by(tru_sim) %>% mutate(Van_peaksRec = sum(tru_sim == Van_peaks$van_sim))
data$BIC_peaksRec[duplicated(data$tru_sim)] = NaN
data$Van_peaksRec[duplicated(data$tru_sim)] = NaN
data=data%>% group_by(No_peak) %>%
    mutate(quantile = ntile(range_cf, 4))

test=data%>% group_by(No_peak) %>% summarise(sensitivityVan = (sum(!is.na(Van)))/n(), sensitivityMS = (sum(!is.na(MS)))/n(), ppvVanNum= (sum(!is.na(Van)))/sum(Van_peaksRec, na.rm = TRUE), ppvBIC= (sum(!is.na(MS)))/ sum(BIC_peaksRec, na.rm = TRUE))

test=data%>% group_by(No_peak, quantile) %>% summarise(sensitivityVan = (sum(!is.na(Van)))/n(), sensitivityMS = (sum(!is.na(MS)))/n(), ppvVanNum= (sum(!is.na(Van)))/sum(Van_peaksRec, na.rm = TRUE), ppvBIC= (sum(!is.na(MS)))/ sum(BIC_peaksRec, na.rm = TRUE), mean_range= mean(range_cf), ntrials= n())

test$No_peak = factor(test$No_peak, levels = c(1,2,3,4))
ggplot(test, aes(quantile, sensitivityVan, colour= No_peak, fill= No_peak, group= No_peak)) + geom_point(size=6, colour= "white")+ geom_point(size=4) + geom_line(size=1.25, linetype = 'dotted') + ggpubr::theme_classic2()   + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size=14), axis.title.y = element_text(size=14), axis.text.y = element_text(size=14), axis.title.x = element_text(size=14)) + xlab("quantile distance between peaks") + ylab("sensitivity") + scale_fill_manual(values=c('#b1c6e6','#91b6ed', '#4f89e0', '#1760cf')) + scale_colour_manual(values=c('#b1c6e6','#91b6ed', '#4f89e0', '#1760cf')) + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.70, 1))
```

```{r plot fmse reviewer }
exponent_BIC= read.csv('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/outputs/aperiodic_exponent_BICREV_range.csv', header = FALSE)

fmse_BIC=read.csv('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/outputs/fmse_mean_BICREV_range.csv', header = FALSE)

stderror <- function(x) sd(x)/sqrt(length(x))

data4plot= data.frame(fmse= c(colMeans(fmse_Van),colMeans(fmse_BIC)), sd_fmse= c(1.96*apply(fmse_Van, 2, stderror),1.96*apply(fmse_BIC, 2, stderror)),
                      algorithm= factor(x = rep(c('Vanilla', 'BIC'), each=83), levels = c('Vanilla', 'BIC')), freq=  seq(4,45,0.5))


ggplot(data4plot, aes(x= freq, y = fmse, fill= algorithm,colour= algorithm, ymin=fmse-sd_fmse, ymax=fmse+sd_fmse)) + geom_ribbon(alpha=0.5, colour= NA) + geom_line() + ggpubr::theme_classic2() + coord_cartesian(xlim = c(4, 45) ) + scale_fill_manual(values=cbbPalette[c(1,3)]) + scale_color_manual(values=cbbPalette[c(1,3)])

ggsave('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/figures/REVIEW_FMSE_plot_new_bounds.pdf', device = "pdf")



someData3= tidyr::tibble(atlas$region, colMeans(MSE_Van), atlas$hemi, 'Vanilla')
someData2= tidyr::tibble(atlas$region, colMeans(MSE_BIC), atlas$hemi, 'BIC')
colnames(someData2)= c('region', 'MSE', 'hemi', 'algorithm')
colnames(someData3)= c('region', 'MSE', 'hemi', 'algorithm')

someData3= someData3[!is.na(someData3$algorithm),]
someData3$algorithm= factor(someData3$algorithm, levels = c(NA,'Vanilla', 'BIC'))
someData3$region= factor(someData3$region)

someData3 %>%
  group_by(algorithm) %>% 
  brain_join(desterieux) %>% 
  reposition_brain(hemi ~ side) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(fill =MSE)) + 
  geom_sf(show.legend = TRUE) + 
  facet_wrap( ~ algorithm) +  scale_fill_continuous_sequential(palette= 'Sunset', rev= FALSE) +  scale_color_continuous_sequential(palette= 'Sunset', rev= FALSE) +
  theme_void() + scale_color_manual('white')

ggsave('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/figures/REVIEW_Brain_map_MSE_compare_range.pdf', device = "pdf")



# box plots of MSE model fit
data4plot= data.frame(MSE= c(rowMeans(MSE_Van), rowMeans(MSE_BIC)),
                      algorithm= factor(x = rep(c('liberal','ms-'), each=606), levels = c('liberal', 'ms-')) , age= factor(demo$Group, c('young adult', 'adult', 'older adult')), age_raw= demo$Age)


ggplot(data4plot, aes(algorithm, MSE, fill=algorithm)) + 
  ggdist::stat_halfeye(adjust = .5, width = .5, .width = 0, justification = -.5, alpha=0.5, point_alpha= 0) + 
  geom_boxplot(width = .2, outlier.shape = NA, outlier.size = 0.001, colour= '#888888') + ggpubr::theme_classic2() + scale_fill_manual(values=cbbPalette[c(1,3)]) + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.008))

ggsave('~/Documents/FOOOF_BICvsVANILLA/figures/REVIEW_boxplot_MSE_compare_range.pdf', device = "pdf")


RVAideMemoire::perm.t.test(rowMeans(MSE_BIC),rowMeans(MSE_Van), nperm=1000)

RVAideMemoire::perm.t.test(data4plot$MSE[data4plot$algorithm=='ms-'],data4plot$MSE[data4plot$algorithm=='liberal'], nperm=1000, paired=TRUE)

# t = -37.992, p-value = 0.001998
```
